selectionRule: An entry is either pinned to an exact version or explicitly unselected with the backlog task that must decide it. A prerequisite required by the active phase may never stay unselected. Ranges are not permitted.

androidGradlePlugin.purpose: Android build plugin for the Mobile lab targets.
androidGradlePlugin.reason: Constrained by the selected Gradle and Android SDK versions.

androidSdk.purpose: Android compile and target SDK levels.
androidSdk.reason: Compile and target levels are chosen when the Android target is bootstrapped.

codeql.reason: Needs a version and image digest, plus a decision on local versus hosted execution and approved data flows.

containerRuntime.purpose: Container runtime for the private lab topology and pinned tool images.
containerRuntime.note: Docker Engine with Compose available. Verified locally with `docker --version`.

gitleaks.reason: Needs a version and image digest.

java.reason: Not installed on the development workstation. Requires a maintained LTS release compatible with the selected Spring Boot line.

javaBuildTool.purpose: Java build, dependency locking and verification.
javaBuildTool.reason: Gradle or Maven, chosen for dependency locking and signature verification support.

javaImage.purpose: Container base image for the Java API lab.
javaImage.reason: Pinned by immutable sha256 digest once the Java LTS release is chosen.

node.purpose: JavaScript runtime for the repository task interface, Console, report generator and test suites.
node.note: Active LTS line. Verified locally with `node --version`.

nodeImage.purpose: Container base image for the Console, report generator and Web lab targets.
nodeImage.reason: A container image is pinned by immutable sha256 digest, not by the host runtime version. Selecting it needs registry access to resolve the digest for the chosen base image.

npm.purpose: Node package manager and workspace lockfile owner.
npm.note: Ships with the pinned Node release. Verified locally with `npm --version`.

postgresql.purpose: Finding Hub and lab target datastore, run as a pinned container image.
postgresql.reason: Runs only as a container image, so it needs an image digest rather than a host binary version. Pin the digest with the Compose topology.

provenanceGenerator.purpose: SLSA/in-toto-compatible build and SBOM attestations for immutable release artifacts.
provenanceGenerator.note: Generated with actions/attest v4.2.2 pinned by commit SHA. ADR-014 separates build provenance from the later release-gate decision and requires OIDC failure to stop promotion.

python.note: Installed and verified with `python3 --version`, which the earlier Microsoft Store stub could not answer. The orchestrator suite runs on it through `node tools/repo.mjs check:orchestrator`.

pythonImage.purpose: Container base image for the orchestrator and Finding Hub.
pythonImage.reason: Pinned by immutable sha256 digest once the Python runtime and package manager are chosen.

pythonPackageManager.purpose: Python dependency resolution and hashed lock format.
pythonPackageManager.note: Ships with the pinned Python. It supports the hashed requirements format docs/05-devsecops/04-static-supply-chain.md requires. Nothing is installed through it yet: the orchestrator is standard library only, so its lock file has no entries to hash.

react.purpose: Console and Web lab user interface framework.
react.reason: Pinned with the first TypeScript application, after confirming compatibility with the selected analyzers.

reactNative.reason: Pinned with the native toolchains it must match.

sbomGenerator.purpose: SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM generation for final artifacts.
sbomGenerator.note: Syft v1.51.1 as pinned by anchore/sbom-action v0.24.2. The action itself is pinned to the exact v0.24.2 commit in actions.

semgrep.purpose: Pattern static analysis and custom rule packs.
semgrep.reason: Needs a version and image digest. Rule packs are versioned with the repository.

signer.purpose: Keyless release signing of approved immutable artifact digests.
signer.note: Cosign v3.1.3 installed by the pinned sigstore/cosign-installer action with an explicit cosign-release input. ADR-014 forbids silent fallback to a long-lived static signing key.

springBoot.reason: Pinned with the Java runtime so the supported-version matrix holds.

swift.reason: Determined by the selected Xcode release.

trivy.note: Trivy v0.70.0 is the default pinned by aquasecurity/trivy-action v0.36.0. Advisory-feed provenance/freshness remains a separate release-policy concern.

typescript.purpose: Typed implementation language for Console, report generator and shared packages.
typescript.reason: No TypeScript module exists yet. Pin the current maintained release when the first module is bootstrapped, together with its compiler and lint toolchain.

xcode.reason: Requires a macOS host, which is not the current development workstation.

zapImage.purpose: Container image for the ZAP passive baseline adapter.
zapImage.reason: Pinned by immutable sha256 digest when the passive ZAP adapter is built. The registry entry names this manifest entry rather than an image, so an adapter cannot pin an unreviewed one.

actionsAttest.note: Immutable v4.2.2 release ref resolved through GitHub's Git data API. Used for build provenance and SBOM attestations.

actionsCheckout.note: Latest release at pinning time. The SHA is the commit the v7.0.1 tag ref resolves to, read from the action repository rather than transcribed from a tag in a workflow file.

actionsSetupPython.note: Installs the pinned Python on the runner so the orchestrator suite runs in CI. Its python-version input must equal the pinned python entry, which the workflow policy asserts.

actionsSetupNode.note: Latest release at pinning time, reviewed together with the checkout pin. Its node-version input must equal the pinned node entry, which the workflow policy asserts.

anchoreSbom.note: Annotated v0.24.2 tag resolves to this commit and pins Syft v1.51.1.

aquaTrivy.note: Signed annotated v0.36.0 tag resolves to this commit and pins Trivy v0.70.0 by default.

cosignInstaller.note: Installer action pinned by full commit SHA; release workflow must also set cosign-release to v3.1.3 so the installed signer version is explicit.

dockerLogin.note: Immutable v4.6.0 release ref resolved through GitHub's Git data API; used only in trusted non-PR release jobs.
